newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Wendy's initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Wendy's initiated as buy.

text.p: -- JP Morgan analyst Erika Gritman Long said she initiated coverage of Wendy's International Inc with a buy rating.
-- She said the next leg of the company's expansion will be "strategic, sustainable and from a healthy base."

-- "Wendy's has the pick of a long, diversified menu of growth options," Long said in a research note. "Growth opportunities ... include both domestic and international expansion, the use of combination formats, increased use of non-traditional sites ... and the introduction of products."
-- The stock was unchanged at 21-1/8 in mid morning exchange activity.
